blocks.title: Thermistor
blocks.text: Thermistor garmi se hassas (heat-sensitive) resistor hai. Zyada tar thermistors ka resistance ka temperature coefficient manfi hai, yaani temperature barhne par un ki resistance ghatti hai; musbat temperature coefficient wale thermistors bhi milte hain.

Thermistors mein temperature barhne par resistance is liye ghatti hai ke barhta temperature charge carriers (electrons ya holes) ko zyada energy deta hai, jis se woh zyada azaadi se chal sakte hain aur resistance kam hoti hai. Thermistors manganese, nickel, cobalt, copper, iron waghaira ke dhaati oxides ke mixtures se bane semiconductor ceramic ko zyada dabao mein garam kar ke banaye jate hain. Inhein matlooba shaklon mein daba kar phir zyada temperature par pakaya (bake kiya) jata hai; yeh beads, rods ya washers ki shakal mein ho sakte hain (Figs. 9.33, thermistor ki alamaat, aur 9.34, thermistors ki aqsam).

blocks.alt: Thermistor ki do alamatein. (a) Daire ke andar resistor ka zigzag aur us ke aar-paar tircha teer. (b) Resistor ka rectangle aur us par chhote seedhe paon wali tirchi lakeer, yaani resistance temperature ke saath badalti hai.
blocks.caption: Thermistor ki alamatein (symbols) (Figure 9.33 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

items: Temperature ki paimaish: thermistors thermometers aur air conditioners, refrigerators, heaters, microwave ovens aur incubators jaise electric aalaat mein temperature par nazar rakhne ke liye istemal hote hain. Zyada manfi temperature coefficient wale thermistors kam temperatures, khaas kar 10 K ke qareeb, napne ke liye bohat durust hain, jahan un ki zyada resistance zyada durust paimaish mumkin banati hai. Temperature sensors ke taur par yeh temperature ki tabdeeli ko electrical voltage mein badalte hain jis par phir amal kiya jata hai; maslan gariyon ke engines mein coolant temperature sensors mein, ta ke engine had se zyada garam na ho, aur digital thermometers mein.

Temperature ki talafi (compensation): thermistors un circuits mein istemal hote hain jahan temperature ki tabdeeli karkardagi par asar dal sakti hai, jaise oscillators, battery charging circuits aur power systems.
Inrush current ki had bandi: thermistors aala pehli baar on karne par current ke ibtidai bahao ko mehdood karne ke liye istemal hote hain.

Voltage divider: thermistors voltage divider mein aam istemal hote hain (Fig. 9.35). Jab thermistor ka temperature barhta hai to us ki resistance ghatti hai, jo us par voltage ki girawat kam karti hai. Nuqte B par potential ki yeh tabdeeli (print kehta hai ke B par potential barhta hai) us se jure circuit ko chalane mein istemal ho sakti hai. Fire alarm mein garam thermistor NOT gate ka input low karta hai; NOT gate ka output high ho kar siren on kar deta hai.

blocks.alt: Battery fixed resistor aur thermistor ke series jor par lagi hai; dono ke darmiyan point B aik NOT gate ko jata hai jo siren chalata hai. Note kehta hai garmi thermistor ki resistance kam karti hai, is liye us par (B par) voltage girta hai; NOT gate ka input low, output high hota hai aur siren bajta hai.

blocks.prompt: Temperature barhne par thermistor ki resistance kyun ghatti hai (short question 9.8)?
blocks.explanation: Thermistor semiconductor ceramic se bana hai. Use garam karna us ke charge carriers ko zyada energy deta hai, to zyada electrons (aur holes) chalne ke liye azaad ho jate hain; carriers ki zyada tadaad zaid takraon se zyada asar karti hai, to resistance ghatti hai, dhaat ke ulat.

items: Thermistor: garmi se hassas resistor, zyada tar NTC (temperature barhne par resistance ghatti hai kyunke carriers energy pate hain); Mn, Ni, Co, Cu, Fe ke oxides ke semiconductor ceramics, beads, rods ya washers ki shakal mein pakaye hue.

Istemalat: temperature ki paimaish (thermometers, aalaat, 10 K ke qareeb, engine coolant sensors, digital thermometers), temperature ki talafi, inrush current ki had bandi, potential dividers (NOT gate wala fire alarm).
